proper_scores_saved.conventions: Probabilities are host-renormalized from frozen candidate next-token log probabilities. Binary Brier is mean squared error; multiclass Brier is sum over classes then mean; log scores use natural logarithms; no numerical floor; conditional relation is scored only when human truth says evidence is sufficient.
